description: Labeled cases for evidence_funnel.py — the cards -> sources -> included -> cited -> bib funnel, and specifically its judgement about WHY a card never reached the prose. The distinction under test is orphan vs expected: a card from an INCLUDED source that no draft cites is extraction that never made it into the paper (the actionable signal), while an own-result card, or a card from a source deliberately excluded or marked duplicate, is uncited by design. A checker that collapsed the two would either bury the real signal in noise or report the author's own Results section as waste.

cases.comment: The signal this tool exists for: a source was read, cards were written, and none of it reached the manuscript.

mutations.breaks: A card from an included source that never reached the prose stops being reported, so extraction work that silently died is invisible — the one thing this tool is for.
Every own-result card is reclassified as an orphan, so a paper's own Results section is reported as wasted extraction and the real orphans drown in it.
Cards from a deliberately excluded or duplicate source are reported as orphans, turning a correct screening decision into a list of complaints.
A card naming its source by registry id no longer resolves to the bib key, so genuinely cited sources are reported as orphans across the whole project.

An included study with no row in the extraction table stops being reported, so a study that passed eligibility and reached no stratum, pool or QUADAS-2 table is invisible — while still counting in the PRISMA included box.
replace: unextracted_included = ([k for k in included if not _has_extraction(k)]

mutations.breaks: Background citations (PRISMA 2020, QUADAS-2, the Reitsma bivariate paper) go back to counting as included studies, so the coverage check names reporting guidelines as studies that contributed no data and disagrees with prisma_flow.py about what 'included' means.
replace: registry = [r for r in registry if r.get("scope") != "background"]

mutations.breaks: Coverage is demanded of every paper type, so a narrative review is told that the sources it cited for context but never extracted are a defect.
replace: coverage_is_required = (ptype in SYNTHESIS_TYPES) or not ptype

mutations.breaks: An extraction record for a study the register never contained stops being reported, so a study that was read and extracted is counted in no PRISMA box and the flow silently understates the review.
